default.cultural_tips: Always remain aware of your surroundings.
default.safe_areas: Well-lit public spaces, main airport terminals.
default.areas_to_avoid: Unlit areas at night, deserted streets.

DE.cultural_tips: Punctuality is highly valued. Cash is still widely used in smaller shops.
DE.safe_areas: Most city centers, public transit during daytime, tourist spots.
DE.areas_to_avoid: Parks at night, areas around major train stations late at night.
DE.lgbtq_safety: Very safe and widely accepted. Berlin and Cologne are particularly LGBTQ+ friendly.
DE.common_scams: Fake petitions or charity workers near train stations.

US.cultural_tips: Tipping 15-20% is customary. Casual dress is generally acceptable.
US.safe_areas: Downtown cores during daytime, university campuses, major tourist spots.
US.areas_to_avoid: Certain inner-city neighborhoods at night. Research your specific destination city.
US.lgbtq_safety: Generally very safe and legally protected, though regional attitudes vary.
US.common_scams: Fake taxis at airports, 'free' CD scams, ticket scalping.

JP.cultural_tips: Modest dress is appreciated. Remove shoes when entering homes or certain traditional venues.
JP.safe_areas: Virtually all areas are very safe, even at night.
JP.areas_to_avoid: Red-light districts (e.g., Kabukicho) can have aggressive touts but are rarely physically dangerous.
JP.lgbtq_safety: Very safe, though public displays of affection are generally uncommon for all couples.
JP.common_scams: Bar touts offering cheap drinks that result in exorbitant cover charges.

GB.cultural_tips: Queuing (lining up) is strictly observed. Politeness is highly valued.
GB.safe_areas: Central London, major tourist attractions, well-lit high streets.
GB.areas_to_avoid: Empty parks at night, some suburban estates.
GB.lgbtq_safety: Very safe with strong legal protections and visible communities.
GB.common_scams: Pickpocketing in crowded tourist areas or on the Tube, fake petitions.

ET.cultural_tips: Dress modestly, covering shoulders and knees. Greeting respectfully is important.
ET.safe_areas: Bole area in Addis Ababa, major hotels, tourist attractions during daytime.
ET.areas_to_avoid: Mercato at night, unlit streets, walking alone after dark.
ET.lgbtq_safety: Same-sex relationships are illegal and highly stigmatized. Extreme discretion is advised.
ET.common_scams: Overcharging for taxis (always negotiate or use a ride-hailing app like Ride), fake tour guides.
